window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-4.title: The Modern House — Journal
window-4.blurb: Every home in here treats a lifetime of accumulated stuff as the actual decor — books on the floor, one perfect lamp, zero styling — which is permission to let all your side-quest objects live out in the open instead of in bins.

window-5.title: Labyrinth — Asia's 50 Best 2026, No. 40
window-5.blurb: It's your whole heritage-meets-remix obsession plated up — chai tao kuay and chilli crab reimagined by a chef who refuses to serve anything that didn't grow here, and exactly the kind of place worth inventing an occasion for.
